about_the_game:
Wake up in a new world and explore its space!

In this interactive and exploratory experience, you find yourself in the center of a remote island surrounded by water and as you wander around you notice the clear separations around you.

The buildings are silent and in ruins, the vegetation sparse and peculiar, the birds look like space rockets...

You also notice various ships on the horizon and sinister pillars disappeared around the island!

You just can't understand what could have gone wrong!

Parallel Multi-Control System!

Switch between mouse and keyboard and controllers by simply picking them up, or use them both at the same time!

Advanced Multi-Camera System!

Switch between first-person, world, or vr views by simply pressing a button!

Day-Night Cycle!

Live in the world as you go through the days and notice the changes in the sky!

Unique Soundtrack!

Let music that reflects the time of day, the area, and the environment accompany you on your adventure!

short_description: Explore a mysterious island where seasons and landscapes merge! In this experience, you will visit different locations on a remote island, crossing its different regions. Uncover the mysteries of the castle, find hidden objects and go on an adventure!
